hypothesis: FOMO (competitors moving faster) is a proven closer for B2B SaaS. Early-mover advantage.

creative.name: Audio-First: Competitive FOMO
creative.headline: While you're dialing, your competitor's AI left 500 voicemails.
creative.primary_text: Press play. Hear what 47 wholesalers already switched to. This AI voicemail gets callbacks because sellers think it's a real person. By the time you cold call 50 numbers today, AgentRVM already hit 10,000.
creative.description: The tool your competitors are already using.

audio_play.text: Your competitor's AI just sent 500 voicemails.

notes: FOMO is psychological. The audio demo + competitive angle is a 1-2 punch. 47 early adopters is a real number that builds credibility.
